description: Drags from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2) over durationMs (default 300; a long duration at one point is a long press), in screenshot pixels like tap. To scroll a list down, swipe upwards. readBack compares screenshots from before and 500 ms after the gesture (so a fling can settle), like tap: screenChanged and changedShare (a list that scrolled, a map that moved). Device control.

height.description: Height of that image; default: the last screenshot.

readBack.description: Compare screenshots from before and after: screenChanged (adds two screenshots and a wait, 1 to 3 s).

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.

width.description: Width of the image the coordinates refer to; default: the last screenshot.

name: swipe
title: Swipe
